# Clarify AI

> AI-powered interview preparation platform: real-time coaching during live interviews via a stealth overlay, full mock-interview engine with AI-graded scorecards, and a prep lab covering behavioral, technical, and system-design rounds.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, comparison, testimonials, FAQ.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Starter, Pro, and Elite plan details and credits.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on interview prep, AI coaching, and career strategy.
- [Help](/help): Help center with how-tos, troubleshooting, and FAQs.
- [Shortcuts](/shortcuts): Keyboard shortcuts for the live overlay and app.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of Service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy Policy and data handling.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a free account (20 credits/month).
- [Log in](/login): Sign in to your Clarify AI account.

## Key features

- Stealth overlay invisible to Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams screen capture.
- Multi-model routing across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
- Mock interview engine with WPM, filler-word, and confidence scoring.
- Resume vs job-description gap analysis.
- BYOK (bring your own API key) on Pro and Elite plans.
